title: Answer: space is absolute, crossed in six unit directions

statements.text: Space is shared and absolute. A machine moves in it only along six directions, left, right, up, down, forward and back, by one fixed distance per tick, so motion has the taxicab geometry of a grid, from which Euclidean rotation is expected to emerge through interaction.

sources.quote: moves in the corresponding direction of space by the same discrete distance on each tick of time.
how Euclidean rotation can emerge in taxicab space, how repulsion, attraction, and gravity can emerge
